VIDEO SCRIPT: MODES OF PRESERVATION OF THE QUR’AN
Grade: Grade 8 · Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Modes of preservation of the Qur’an. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity
• recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• Model 1: describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity
• Model 2: recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Practise: describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity
• Practise: recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Modes of preservation of the Qur’an.”

— CBC Learn · Video Hub script aligned to lesson + revision
